cluster_label: epidermal cell of the abdominal posterior compartment
working_definition: Adult abdominal epidermal cells of the posterior compartment (FCA body wall); authors gave no FBbt term (Manual Annotation).

best_match.fbbt_definition: Any epidermal cell of the adult.

justification: FBbt has no term for posterior-compartment abdominal epidermal cells; adult epidermal cell is the closest valid parent.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Any epithelial cell that is part of some epidermis.

recommendation: Use adult epidermal cell (FBbt:00058242) as a broad match.
